title: FBI Photo B19
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report to AARO containing a single redacted IR still image of a UAP, noting that the system timestamp is incorrect.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome IR/SWIR image from a military targeting system showing a small, dark, elongated object centered in a crosshair reticle.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, somewhat elongated object is positioned slightly above the horizontal crosshair
